environment.working_tree: Modified worktree (50 paths): Products planning/evidence, Catalog adapter/tests and local migrations; no Supabase remote writes or migration applications.

decisions.summary: One Products master covers finished products, raw materials/components and services; semimanufactured items remain deferred.
Product class is independent of purchasing, selling and inventory-tracking uses.
The product base has one general category; each separately managed/sold SKU has its own primary category, which may differ from the base and sibling variants.
Buy/make/both sourcing is product-owned and inherited by variants.
A variant is a specific product managed or sold separately, with its own SKU distinct from sibling variants.
Each variant/SKU has its own independently assigned category; the product base retains a general category and SKU categories may differ.
Products and categories are organization-scoped and shared across workspaces; legacy workspace IDs need migration handling.

Product, variant and category keys are LoopDev-generated, immutable, distinct from SKU/name and unique organization-wide. SKU uniqueness is organization-wide after trimming outer whitespace and comparing case-insensitively while preserving entered case.

Only legacy service maps automatically to Service; physical_product, digital_product, subscription, coverage, package and fee remain drafts until explicitly reviewed. Legacy categoryKey mapping remains open.
A draft product/SKU may omit category; a category is required before activation.

Archive preserves existing assignments and blocks new ones; permanent deletion is prohibited; restore and subtree-preserving reparent rules are confirmed; archiving is blocked while active children remain.
Finished products allow buy/make/both; raw materials/components are buy-only for now; services have no sourcing value. Revisit raw-material sourcing during Manufacturing discovery.
OrganizationCatalog is migration-only, not a target business entity or product-ownership boundary.
Commercial price currency is owned by each PriceBook; migrate the legacy OrganizationCatalog currency into applicable books.
Preserve legacy category keys as provenance and require a reviewed record-level mapping; never infer target categories from opaque legacy keys.
Locale and channel are outside Products scope for this release; preserve them as migration provenance and defer ownership to future localization/channel work.
Each PriceEntry uses the currency of its PriceBook; legacy PriceEntry.currency is not an independent target value.
Offer has no independent currency; offer prices use the currency of their associated PriceBook.
Cost reference belongs to the purchasable unit: product when no SKUs exist, otherwise independent values per purchasable SKU with no inheritance.
Each cost reference carries its own ISO currency; there is no automatic conversion or inheritance from a sales PriceBook.
Physical measurements are independent per managed unit, with optional weight in kg and dimensions in cm for this release.
Product/SKU alt text belongs to the media assignment, not the reusable Platform File.
Product media is organization-scoped and reusable; Platform Files owns bytes/common file metadata while ERP Products owns the association.
Purchase cost is an optional current value; cost history/source requirements are not confirmed.
Detaching a Product media assignment preserves the reusable asset and shared Platform File.
Product and SKU galleries support multiple media assignments with an explicit manual order scoped to each target gallery.

Documented entity/cardinality, lifecycle transitions, invariants, commands and proposed domain events.
Recorded per-entity ownership, local fixture strategy, remote identity, archive/delete/restore behavior and event boundaries.

requirements.evidence: Current catalog entities and constraints are documented; only legacy service maps automatically to Service, while physical_product, digital_product, subscription, coverage, package and fee remain drafts pending explicit review. Legacy categoryKey mapping, ownership of legacy OrganizationCatalog fields, deletion policy and version/audit rules remain unresolved.

Organization-wide scope, separate product-base/SKU categories, activation timing, archive-only behavior, restore conditions, subtree-preserving reparenting, blocking parent archive while active children remain, and organization-unique generated immutable category keys are confirmed.
Organization-scoped reusable files, product/SKU assignments and context-specific alt text are defined; file retention, shared metadata ownership and Platform renditions remain open.
Per-purchasable-unit cost ownership, no inheritance and per-reference ISO currency are confirmed; history/source and currency-specific decimal precision remain open.
Product-versus-SKU ownership, non-inheritance and metric kg/cm units are confirmed; activation-required fields and runtime storage are not verified.
CRM remains source of truth for Contact identity and history; Products references it without duplicating the customer master.

evidence.result: Attempt 11 records the source reconciliation, unchanged domain decisions, current runtime boundary and unresolved risks.
Documents decisions, relationships, lifecycle, invariants, events, per-entity continuity and open questions.
Legacy catalog schema, scoped uniqueness, category_key representation and cascading deletes were compared with the target model.
Current local adapter CRUD, status and fixture behavior was treated as baseline, not target policy.
Current media tables, shared Storage policy changes, physical-delete grants and cascading relationships were compared with reusable-file and archive-only semantics.
Current organization media listing, direct upload, assignment, per-assignment alt text, detach and signed-preview behavior was inspected; no rendition processing exists.
Product Owner confirmed: “Sí, permitir orden manual”; ordering is scoped to each product/SKU gallery.

notes: Cost history/source and currency-specific precision remain open; no value conversion is implied.
Manual product/SKU gallery ordering was confirmed after the original attempt-7 completion and is documented as DOM-ERP-031.
Platform must approve shared Files ownership, asset retention and the append-only audit contract before remote write behavior is enabled.
Remote schema/deployment state and authorized legacy-data dry run remain unverified; no production migration is authorized by this domain checkpoint.
